Also, with AI help, I computed ISI in various ways: using mean of per-unit ISIs or pooled mean, and using held-in, held-out, and all neurons for all four maze datasets. The pooled mean on held-in neurons from MC Maze Small was the only combination that matched the reported 221.9 ms.
